name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to the distilled 32B variant fine-tuned on EXCAVA’s exact task data. The 32B model delivers sub-30ms latency without pipeline breaks, preserving real-time performance while still netting a measurable 0.5%+ quality gain over base models. The trade-off is accepting a slightly smaller absolute quality bump than the 70B variant, but the real-time stability and lower compute cost make it the only viable path to hit the 0.5% target without breaking the pipeline. Benchmark it against the 70B in the 1000-sample test Dynamo set—if it meets the quality threshold, flip the switch.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just latency—it’s benchmark drift. A 32B distilled model’s 0.5% gain could vanish under live task variance, while a 70B’s margin is more stable. Test both against Sonnet 3.7’s 0.7% baseline with 5000 samples; if the 32B’s drift exceeds 0.3%, stick with the 70B.
